pages.text: Altered from $(5)Smite$(), $(5)Bane of Arthropods$() or $(5)Impaling$(), $(4)Hunter's Exultation$() greatly increases damage against enemies that are undead, arthropods or aquatic, in return decreasing the base damage dealt against everything else. Maximum level is $(4)V$() and it conflicts with $(5)Sharpness$(), $(5)Smite$(), $(5)Bane of Arthropods$(), $(5)Impaling$() and $(4)Xenophobia$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Hunter's Exultation represents a more 'general use' version of its original enchantments, yet it's still more limited than something like Sharpness.
